headline: U.S. consumer confidence rises in November to its highest level in nearly two years
summary: US consumer confidence jumped in November to its highest level in almost two years. The rise reflected optimism about the labour market and the economy after the midterm elections.
why: Consumer confidence is a leading indicator of household spending, which accounts for most of US economic activity.
original_headline: Confianza de los consumidores en EU aumenta en noviembre a su nivel más alto en casi dos años
